checks.name: pl_range at a point contains the exact rational interpolant (the review's 1.85 and 300 random points)
pl_slope_range at 0.05 contains the exact rational slope of that cell
the kernel point range at 0.5 contains the direct Arb evaluation, as a ball
grid_range at a point contains the exact rational bilinear value (200 random points)
a value 2^-70 below the target is not accepted by the ball comparison the verdicts use
the intact small sharp tape passes in sample mode
a forged one-byte tube-leaf tape on the no-tube candidate is refused
claiming a tube radius for the sharp candidate is refused: no tube theorem is about it
a full check with one unresolved obligation exits 1 with status incomplete
a --limit run is refused as incomplete (obligations skipped)
a tape with its last byte deleted is refused
a tape with one leaf deleted from the middle is refused
a tape with a whole subtree replaced by one discharged leaf is refused (the node counts disagree, or the box does not clear the target)
flipping every collapse direction is refused, with refutations
an altered pair coefficient is refused, with refuted leaves
a raised target is refused, with refuted leaves
metadata whose digest does not match the tape is refused
an opcode with a coordinate out of range is refused
the results carry the source hashes taken at the start, and the replay command with its options

what: controls for the tape checker: forged and mutated proof objects refused, enclosure primitives contain independently computed exact values
